title: Page 5
content_zh:
普宁这才点头要女官收下。
“帮我拿去洗洗……”她说完后看向胡里。“你说你叫什么名字？”
“回禀公主，小的姓胡，单名一个里字。”普宁本就国色天香，这会和颜悦色，更是美得教胡里心儿不住狂跳。
普宁慢条斯理地唤：“胡里。”
“小的在。”
“记得，回去帮我跟你们家大人，说我谢谢他。”
“回禀公主，小的绝不会忘。”
回到队伍后边，胡里还一脸晕陶陶。
不待主子询问，他辟哩啪啦就是一串赞美。“大人，公主长得真的是－－跟仙子一样！刚才小的送礼过去，公主一见小的手里捧着什么，立刻冲着小的一笑，那笑……哎呦！”
胡里捱了一记爆栗。
于季友没好气地说：“公主长得多美我没眼睛看？啰啰嗦嗦一堆。你到底要不要告诉我公主说了什么？”
说也怪，早先听胡里夸赞，他心里毫无感觉，可这会儿再听，却挺不是滋味，感觉好像应该属于他的什么，被人占去了似的。
胡里挲头傻笑。“公主好秀气好温柔地说－－‘记得，帮我跟你家主子说，我谢谢他’……”胡里拔尖嗓音模仿着，后一拍掌。“您不晓得公主说那话的表情多美，真的，就跟……”
“仙子一样。”于季友接口。普宁那娇样他昨晚也见过，根本不需胡里再三提醒。“老这一句，可不可以换个新词？”
“小的学问又没大人好……”胡里嘟嚷。“不过说真的，大人那几颗甜杏，还送得真妙。”
于季友心里觉得开心，又不想教胡里知道。谁教他早先说了一堆狠话，这会儿再去讨好人家，不成了自掌嘴巴？
“说完了就归队，我想四处巡逻看看。”
胡里收起笑脸。“怎么了？大人觉得哪儿不对？”
“太安静了。”他回顾后方跟径。
虽说深林野地闲人不多，可一路行来，林间连只鸟儿、野兔也没看见，实在不太对劲。

于季友从小跟着他爹南征北讨，天生是块习武领兵的料子，对于他人难以感觉的风吹草动，他直觉向来神准。
他这特点，久跟在他身边的胡里自然十分清楚。
不啰嗦，胡里随即调转马头，跟着巡视去。
中午，真如胡里提醒的那般，大队没扎营煮食，只派护卫送来烤饼、腊羊肉跟几壶清水，要所有人就地用膳，半个时辰即刻动身。
坐在轿上的普宁刚吃了一点，灾难突如其来降临。
斗大的尖石暴雨似地打来，众人闪避不及，只能拿头手硬挡，没一会儿几人额上手上全是鲜血。
“是盗匪！快保护公主－－”
“保护公主－－”
一阵兵荒马乱中，蹄声吼声跟着响起，仍摸不着头绪的普宁掀帘欲看，“啪”地一声，一颗尖石正正打中轿棂，吓得她赶忙缩手。
“危险，公主，您千万别出来！”
帷幔后，普宁看见女官们群起护在轿前，挡得她豕没法瞧清楚状况。“别挣挡着我，快口诉我怎么回事？”
“前头后边全围满了盗匪……啊！”
一女官刚答完，一阵箭雨四落，手无缚鸡之力的女官们根本没闪箭的能力，只能拿身子护驾。
帷幔后，普宁瞠着大眼看着女官们像被射中的雀鸟一般，无力摔跌在地。
一女官后腰中管，身子痉挛，突然跌进轿中。
不假思索，普宁伸手搀扶。“你怎么了？”
“公主……”一句话还没说完，女官便没了声息。
“不，你醒醒，怎么会这样！”
普宁泪眼汪汪拍着女官面颊，她记得这位女官，刚才京是她端膳来的，怎么才一会儿，人就死掉了？！
外边呢？外边人没事吧？

她踉跄跨出彩轿，放眼望，是怎般的凄惨场面。轿前，是以身挡箭而死的女官们，每个人身上背上全桶满了箭杆。远些，是横列着惨死的轿夫们，面前，尽是踩脏的烤饼跟腊羊肉，江血浸湿了泥地。
杀声吼声、铁刃相击声不绝于耳。
这些人，是为了保护她才死的。
“对不起……”普宁哭泣着捂上一女官瞠直的双眼。
“公主，危险，快进轿！”正与贼匪缠斗的护卫一见普宁出轿，奋力顶开贼匪。
她抬眼一见贼匪提刀追来，大喊：“小心！”
“呀”地一声惨叫，一把刀自护卫胸口穿透。
她脸发白地瞪着透出护卫前胸的血刀，穿着红衫的身子猛退，刚才咽下的烤饼在肚中翻搅，几乎教她呕出。
“你就是公主？”满脸黑胡的贼匪抽出长刀，朝普宁一瞪。
不！她现在该怎么办？有谁能来救救她？
连连后退的普宁被倒在轿前的女官绊倒，整个人跌坐在地。
“跟我走。”贼匪伸手。
“拿开你的脏手。”
骑着白驹赶来的于季友一个蹬跳，长脚便将贼匪踢得老远。他旋身搀起普宁，黑眸在她脸上转了一圈。“没事吧？有没有伤着哪里？”
“我没事。”她拿手一抹泪湿的脸颊，而后抬头，看见贼匪又擒刀冲来。“小心！”
“后退。”于季友身一转，即时横剑挡下了长刀。
阳光下，腾腾闪耀的长剑犹如银蛇乱舞，贼匪似没想到队伍中藏有这般高手，一时接应不暇。
回身一见伙伴只在远处观望，不肯前来援手，贼匪才放声怒：“还傻在那干嘛！”
闻声，众贼才回过神似，一拥向前。
他有危险。

瞧见倏地变多的贼匪，普宁想到于季友极可能会像伺候她的女官们一样，惨死在他们手中，不行，她得想个法子帮他，她不想再看见任何人因她死去。
她唇一抿，回头，几颗尖石就落在她脚边不远。不作它想，她拾起，朝贼匪头上身上痛砸。“打死你们、打死你们！”
也许是砸头的尖石唤醒众贼的记忆，也或许是发现于季友难以轻取，几名贼匪放弃对峙，改冲到普宁面前。他们想到，只要拿下公主，哪怕有再多高人，也不是他们对手。
一见情况不对，于季友不恋栈，立刻赶到曾宁身边。
“抓紧我。”他揪住她后腰，一矮身便要跃出贼阵。
“往哪逃！”贼匪手快，刀一横更朝普宁身侧劈去，摆明宁可错杀，也不肯放过一人。
于季友只能拿背挡下这一刀。
“小心！”普宁大叫。
“抓紧！”捱砍也没能阻挡他窜飞的动作，一个踮步踏上轿顶，再一跃，两人便一同上了树头，目标是停在远处的白驹。现在第一要务，是将普宁安然送离险地。
紧抱他腰杆的手摸到一阵湿热，普宁瞪大眼讶然道：“你流血了？！”
“小伤。”纵使疼得脸色发白，他仍要强装没事。几个蹬跳将普宁送到马上，回头又砍了几名贼匪，这才翻身上马。
她偷空看着自己沾满红血的双手，身子不住发抖。
于季友察觉她的反应，问道：“冷么？”
“你看你……”她小手儿往他面前一凑，泪如雨下。“好多血！”
“我是石头人，捱一点伤不要紧。”他手一推要她抓住铠甲，头就低在她香香的发上低语：“抓紧，我要催马快跑，免得贼匪想到拿箭射我们。”
“有人要带公主逃跑！”匪阵中传来喊声。
风声杀声呼呼拂过普宁耳朵，她怕得不敢张眼，只能埋头偎进他胸膛，随着他每个挥剑退敌的动作，感觉他全身肌理的起伏。
普宁想起早先他飞奔前来救她的英雄举动，心旌动摇。原来父王的眼光没错，现在为了保护她奋战不懈的男人，确实是个可以依靠的铁铮铮汉子。
content_en:
Puning then nodded and asked the female officer to accept it.
"Help me take it and wash it..." After she finished speaking, she looked at Hu Li. "What did you say your name was?"
"Princess, my surname is Hu, and my name has one Chinese character." Puning was already very beautiful, but now she is so kind and beautiful, Hu Li's heart can't help but beat wildly because of her beauty.
Puning called out slowly: "Hu Li."
"The little one is here."
"Remember, go back and help me tell your adults that I thank him."
"Reply to the princess, I will never forget it."
Back at the back of the team, Hu Li was still looking dazed.
Without waiting for the master to ask, he responded with a string of compliments. "Sir, the princess really looks like a fairy! Just now, the little one was giving gifts. When the princess saw what the little one was holding, she immediately smiled at the little one. That smile... Ouch!"
Hu Li received a violent blow.
Yu Jiyou said angrily: "I don't have the eyes to see how beautiful the princess is? That's a lot of nonsense. Do you want to tell me what the princess said?"
Strangely enough, when he heard Hu Li's praise earlier, he felt nothing in his heart, but now when he heard it again, it was quite unpleasant. He felt as if something that should belong to him had been taken away by someone else.
Hu Li nodded and smiled stupidly. "The princess was so delicate and gentle when she said - 'Remember, help me tell your master that I thank him'..." Hu Li imitated with a high-pitched voice, and then clapped his hands. "You don't know how beautiful the princess' expression was when she said those words. Really, just like..."
"Like a fairy." Yu Jiyou responded. He had also seen Puning's cute look last night, and there was no need for Hu Li to remind her again and again. "Can you use a new word for this old sentence?"
"The knowledge of young people is not as good as that of adults..." Hu Li muttered. "But to be honest, those sweet apricots were a wonderful gift, sir."
Yu Jiyou felt happy in his heart, but he didn't want to teach Hu Li to know. Who taught him that he had said a lot of harsh words earlier, and now he was trying to please others, so he would end up licking his own tongue?
"After that, we will return to the team. I want to patrol around."
Hu Li put away his smile. "What's wrong? Sir, do you think something is wrong?"
"It's too quiet." He looked back to follow the path.
Although there weren't many people in the deep woods and fields, I didn't see even a single bird or hare in the forest along the way, which really didn't feel right.
Yu Jiyou has been following his father on military expeditions since he was a child. He was born to be a martial arts leader, and his intuition has always been accurate when it comes to disturbances that are difficult for others to detect.
Hu Li, who has been with him for a long time, is naturally very aware of this characteristic of his.
Without further ado, Hu Li immediately turned his horse's head and followed the patrol.
At noon, just as Hu Li reminded, the brigade did not set up camp and cook. They only sent guards to deliver scones, bacon and a few pots of water. They asked everyone to eat on the spot and set off in half an hour.
Puning, who was sitting on the sedan chair, had just eaten a little when disaster struck suddenly.
Large sharp rocks came like a rainstorm, and everyone could not dodge them, so they could only block them with their heads and hands. Soon, their foreheads and hands were covered with blood.
"It's a bandit! Protect the princess quickly——"
"Protect the princess——"
There was a chaos of war, followed by the sound of hoofbeats and roars. Puning, who was still confused, lifted the curtain to take a look. There was a "pop", and a sharp stone hit the sedan lattice, which scared her and she quickly shrank her hands.
"Danger, princess, please don't come out!"
Behind the curtain, Puning saw the female officials gathered in front of the sedan, blocking her from seeing the situation clearly. "Stop trying to block me, tell me quickly what's going on?"
"The front and back are surrounded by bandits...ah!"
As soon as a female officer finished her answer, a shower of arrows fell in all directions. The female officers, who had no strength to restrain the chicken, had no ability to dodge the arrows, so they could only use their bodies to protect them.
Behind the curtain, Puning watched with wide eyes as the female officials fell to the ground helplessly like shot birds.
A female official suffered a puncture in her lower back, her body convulsed, and she suddenly fell into the sedan chair.
Without thinking, Puning stretched out his hand to help. "What's wrong with you?"
"Princess..." Before she could finish her sentence, the female officer fell silent."No, wake up, why is this happening!"
With tears in her eyes, Puning patted the female official's cheek. She remembered that this female official was the one who brought the meal to Jing just now. Why did he die in just a short time? !
What about outside? Are people outside okay?
She staggered out of the sedan chair and looked around, seeing what a miserable scene it was. In front of the sedan, there were female officials who died by blocking the arrows with their bodies. Each of them had a bucket full of arrow shafts on their backs. Farther away, the bearers who had died tragically were lined up. In front of them were trampled dirty pancakes and cured mutton, and the mud was soaked with river blood.
The sounds of killing roars and the clashing of iron blades are endless.
These people died to protect her.
"I'm sorry..." Puning cried and covered the eyes of a female official.
"Princess, it's dangerous, get in the sedan quickly!" The guard who was fighting with the bandits saw Puning getting out of the sedan and tried his best to push away the bandits.
She raised her eyes and saw the thief chasing after him with a knife, and shouted: "Be careful!"
"Yeah" screamed, and a knife penetrated the guard's chest.
She stared at the bloody knife on the guard's chest with a pale face, and her body in the red shirt retreated sharply. The scones she had just swallowed were churning in her stomach, almost making her vomit.
"Are you the princess?" The black-bearded bandit drew out his long knife and glared at Puning.
No! What should she do now? Who can come to save her?
Puning, who was retreating continuously, was tripped by the female official who fell in front of the sedan chair, and fell to the ground.
"Follow me." Thief held out his hand.
"Get your dirty hands off."
Yu Jiyou, who came riding on a white horse, jumped up and kicked the thief far away with his long legs. He turned around and helped Puning up, his dark eyes turning around her face. "Are you okay? Are you injured anywhere?"
"I'm fine." She wiped her tear-stained cheek with her hand, then raised her head and saw the thief rushing towards her again with a knife. "Be careful!"
"Back off." Yu Jiyou turned around and blocked the long sword with his horizontal sword.
Under the sun, the shining long sword danced like a silver snake. The thieves seemed not to have expected that there was such a master in the team, and they were overwhelmed at the moment.
When he turned around and saw that his companion was only watching from a distance and refused to come to help, the thief burst out angrily: "What are you doing there?"
Hearing the sound, all the thieves came to their senses and swarmed forward.
He is in danger.
Seeing the number of thieves that were suddenly increasing, Puning thought that Yu Jiyou would probably die tragically in their hands like the female officials who served her. No, she had to find a way to help him. She didn't want to see anyone die because of her.
She pursed her lips and turned around. Several sharp stones landed not far from her feet. Without thinking, she picked it up and hit the thief on the head and body. "I'll beat you to death, I'll beat you to death!"
Perhaps the sharp stone smashed on the head awakened the memories of the thieves, or perhaps they found that Yu Jiyou was difficult to take lightly. Several thieves gave up the confrontation and rushed to Puning instead. They thought that as long as they captured the princess, no matter how many experts there were, they would not be able to match them.
When he saw something was wrong, Yu Jiyou rushed to Zeng Ning's side immediately.
"Hold on to me." He grabbed her waist and jumped out of the bandit formation.
"Where to run!" The thief was quick and slashed Puning's side with his knife, making it clear that he would rather kill someone by mistake than let anyone go.
Yu Jiyou could only block the blow with his back.
"Be careful!" Puning shouted.
"Hurry up!" Even the chop could not stop him from flying. He stepped onto the top of the sedan with one tiptoe, and with another leap, the two of them climbed up the tree together, aiming for the white horse parked in the distance. The first priority now is to get Puning out of danger safely.
The hand hugging his waist felt wet and warm. Puning's eyes widened and he said in surprise: "Are you bleeding?!"
"Small injury." Even though his face turned pale from the pain, he still pretended to be fine. With a few kicks, Puning was sent to the horse. He turned around and chopped down a few more bandits before he got back on the horse.
She took a moment to look at her hands, which were stained with red blood, and her body couldn't help but tremble.
Yu Jiyou noticed her reaction and asked, "Is it cold?"
"Look at you..." She put her little hand in front of him, tears streaming down her face. "So much blood!"
"I am stoneLeader, it doesn't matter if you get hurt a little. He pushed her to grab the armor, then lowered his head on her fragrant hair and whispered: "Hold on, I want to urge the horse to run faster, lest the thieves think of shooting us with arrows." "
“Someone is taking the princess to escape! "A shout came from the bandit formation.
The sound of the wind and the sound of killing blew past Puning's ears. She was too scared to open her eyes, so she could only bury her head and nestle into his chest, feeling the ups and downs of his body's texture with every move he made with his sword to repel the enemy.
Puning recalled his heroic act of rushing to save her earlier, and his heart was shaken. It turns out that her father's vision was right, and the man who is now fighting tirelessly to protect her is indeed a strong man who can be relied on.
